// Builds the org-context query. Validation lives in the Router node -- this
// node only re-checks the SHAPE of the pre-quoted lists, so a future edit to
// Router that loosens its regexes cannot silently open a SQL injection path
// here. The pattern below matches exactly what Router emits and nothing else.
const LIST_RE = /^(?:'(?:pro_)?[0-9a-fA-F-]+'|-?[0-9]+)(?:, (?:'(?:pro_)?[0-9a-fA-F-]+'|-?[0-9]+))*$/;

// $input.first(), not $json: this node runs once for ALL items, where $json
// is undefined.
const routed = $input.first().json;
const lists = {
  __UUID_LIST__: routed.uuid_list,
  __PRO_UUID_LIST__: routed.pro_uuid_list,
  __INT_LIST__: routed.int_list,
};
for (const [placeholder, value] of Object.entries(lists)) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !LIST_RE.test(value)) {
    throw new Error(`${placeholder} is not a well-formed pre-quoted id list`);
  }
}

// Lowercase quoted aliases are REQUIRED: Snowflake returns column names
// uppercase, and index_rows_by_org() in org_context_contract.py looks up
// the literal key 'org_uuid'. The 44 columns are: 'org_uuid',
// 'contract_version', 'audience_query_version' (run metadata, not an org
// field -- Waypoint captures it as batch lineage and drops it from org
// briefs), then 41 of the 43 names in ALLOWED_FIELDS (n8n.py). The two
// missing names are allowlisted but have NO source column here, and
// degrade to None client-side, which n8n.py's header explicitly allows:
// 'email_consent_state' never had one, and 'sms_consent_state' was
// REMOVED 2026-08-19 -- its source, communications_sms_consents, records
// the Pro's CUSTOMERS' marketing-SMS consent, not the Pro's own, so it
// gated the sms channel on the wrong party and pushed consent language
// into recommendations. (An earlier version of this comment said 46; it
// was counting the phantom email field.) The
// 'org-context-v2' literal below must match CONTRACT_VERSION exactly --
// on a mismatch minimize_row() refuses EVERY row, by design. Adding
// columns is contract-compliant (v2 allows additive fields); Waypoint
// drops any name not yet in its allowlist.
const template = `-- Org context pack, contract org-context-v2. Built inline over live tables;
-- ANALYTICS.MAIN.PATHFINDER_ORG_CONTEXT_V1 never existed and is not referenced.
--
-- PERF SHAPE: this query resolves its own spine from the raw submitted ids
-- (candidates -> resolved -> spine). It used to be handed a list of org_uuids
-- by the Router Query node, which forced two Snowflake round trips to run
-- back to back. Router Query still exists, but only to feed pro_uuid to
-- Iterable, and now runs in PARALLEL with this one instead of ahead of it.
--
-- PERF DEBT -- SIX BANDS ARE SUSPENDED, EMITTING NULL:
--   last_job_activity_band, open_ar_band, ar_aging_band, platform_usage_band,
--   health_grade, upsell_grade
--
-- ponytail: six fields traded for ~200 GB per call. Restore them via nightly
-- per-org rollups, NOT by putting the removed CTEs back.
--
-- ALL FIGURES BELOW WERE MEASURED, not estimated -- five orgs per probe,
-- via get_query_operator_stats.
--
-- CAUSE 1, the big one: health_index_yesterday is a VIEW, and cost 25.4s /
-- 74.3 GB alone. It recomputes the entire health index -- including
-- last_value(...) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_id ORDER BY bizdate) over
-- all of agg_organization_plan_by_bizdate -- so its window frames are built
-- for every org before any outer filter applies. Its operator profile is full
-- of tables this query never names (RAW_FIVETRAN_PROD.SERVICE_REQUESTS at
-- 38.8%, time-tracking entries, product activity, bills, charges).
-- The cancels CTE below recovers the cancel signals from the base table for
-- 0.28s / 0.18 GB. The two GRADES have no materialized source and are gone.
--
-- CAUSE 2: NO table in analytics.main has a clustering key (verified:
-- cluster_by empty on all 14 this query touched). A WHERE on organization_id
-- prunes NOTHING, and neither does a date floor:
--   service_requests_details    76.3 GB  4480/4480 partitions  (lastjob)
--   dim_invoice                 29.0 GB  1792/1792 partitions  (ar)
--   fact_job_invoiced_estimate  19.7 GB  1160/1160 partitions  (plat)
-- Adding job_created_date >= DATEADD(day,-400,...) to lastjob still scanned
-- 4480/4480. There is no predicate that makes those three tables cheap.
--
-- What DOES fix the remaining six: a nightly per-org rollup carrying
-- last_job_date, open_ar_usd, max_days_overdue, the 90d mobile/web send
-- split, and the two health grades -- ~200k rows, clustered on
-- organization_id. Needs write access this credential does not have.
--
-- CHECKED AND FINE, do not "optimize" these: account_ltv is 5 MB / 0.34s, so
-- the APPROX_PERCENTILE in ltvcut is already cheap. agg_current_customer is
-- 20 MB, orginfo 20 MB, detail_retention_cases 20 MB.
--
-- CORRECTNESS TRAPS -- both are SILENT when wrong (the query still succeeds
-- and still returns a plausible band):
--   * dim_invoice.DUE_AMOUNT is in CENTS. Always /100.0, or every AR band is
--     100x high and every org looks like a collections emergency.
--     (agg_current_customer T28_*_AMOUNT columns are DOLLARS -- verified
--     median 28d CC volume approx 8.5k USD -- do NOT divide those.)
--
-- NO LITERAL DOLLAR SIGN may appear anywhere in this SQL text (including
-- this comment): dollar-sequences are replacement patterns to JS
-- String.replace(). Every substitution below uses split/join instead, but
-- the rule stands -- one future .replace() call would splice the query
-- silently. That is also why the segment guard below is an IN list, not a
-- regex anchored with a dollar.
--   * INVOICE_STATUS is paid | draft | open | canceled. Open AR filters to
--     'open' ONLY; for one sampled org 'draft' was ~6x the real open balance.
--
-- SPINE is analytics.main.dim_organization (926,837 rows, strictly 1:1
-- ORG_UUID <-> ORGANIZATION_ID). marts.customer_base.agg_current_customer is
-- NOT the spine: it holds 64,480 CURRENT customers only, so spining on it
-- would silently refuse churned orgs -- exactly the outreach targets. It is a
-- LEFT JOIN source only. The spine also carries segment_actual (closed
-- 1A-4D / A-D vocabulary, ~100% populated, vocabulary-guarded below) and
-- currently_paying / billing_suspended for lifecycle_stage -- both work for
-- churned orgs.
--
-- NOTED DEVIATION 1: jobs/estimates/outreach 28d bands, quickbooks USAGE, and
-- the v2.1 acc-derived bands (payments_28d_band, email_engagement_state,
-- marketing_campaigns_28d_band, leads_created_28d_band,
-- jobs_reviewed_28d_band, wisetack_state, mrr_band, and the
-- open_retention_case arm of churn_risk_state) come from pre-aggregated
-- agg_current_customer to control cost. For the ~93% of orgs absent from it
-- those fields are NULL rather than wrong. health_grade / upsell_grade /
-- cancel-request signals likewise come from
-- production.customer_success.health_index_yesterday (current customers
-- only; absent -> NULL). NULL is contract-compliant: minimize_row drops
-- blank allowlisted values rather than asserting them.
--
-- NOTED DEVIATION 4 (v2): four attached features have NO verified usage source
-- (voip, card_on_file, time_tracking, flat_rate_pricing). When attached they
-- emit 'attached_usage_unknown'. That is NOT collapsed into 'attached_unused':
-- "we cannot see whether they use it" and "they pay and do not use it" drive
-- opposite outreach, and the whole point of v2 is keeping them apart.
--
-- REMOVED 2026-08-19: sms_consent_state. Its source table
-- (communications_sms_consents) records the Pro's CUSTOMERS' marketing-SMS
-- consent, not the Pro's own -- MAX(opted_out) over any customer row marked
-- nearly every org opted_out and blocked the sms channel for the wrong
-- reason. Do NOT re-add it from that table.
--
-- BANDS ONLY. No raw amount, count, date, free-text string, or identifier
-- crosses this boundary. 'vertical' is mapped from 174 dirty distinct source
-- values onto a closed 16-value vocabulary; 'recommended_focus' is filtered
-- against the 34 verified feature names and otherwise emits 'other'.
-- 'segment' is guarded onto its closed vocabulary; health/upsell
-- grades are guarded onto closed 3-value vocabularies; everything from
-- health_index free-text columns (reason_*, cancel_reason) is NOT emitted.
WITH candidates AS (
  -- Three UNION arms instead of one OR spanning both sides of a join: each
  -- arm prunes on its own key. UNION dedupes an org submitted twice under
  -- two different id spaces.
  SELECT o.org_uuid, o.organization_id
    FROM analytics.main.dim_organization o
   WHERE o.org_uuid IN (__UUID_LIST__)
  UNION
  SELECT o.org_uuid, o.organization_id
    FROM analytics.main.dim_organization o
   WHERE o.organization_id IN (__INT_LIST__)
  UNION
  SELECT o.org_uuid, o.organization_id
    FROM analytics.main.dim_organization o
    JOIN analytics.main.dim_service_pro p
      ON p.organization_id = o.organization_id
   WHERE p.pro_uuid IN (__PRO_UUID_LIST__)
),
resolved AS (
  -- Admin-pro EXISTS filter, not a join: it reproduces exactly the row set
  -- Router Query used to hand us (orgs with at least one unarchived admin
  -- pro) without needing to pick WHICH pro, which only Iterable cares about.
  -- Drop this CTE and orgs with no admin pro would start appearing in the
  -- response with null Iterable fields -- a real behavior change.
  SELECT c.org_uuid, c.organization_id AS oid
    FROM candidates c
   WHERE EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM analytics.main.dim_service_pro p
      WHERE p.organization_id = c.organization_id
        AND p.is_admin = true
        AND p.archived = false
   )
),
spine AS (
  SELECT r.org_uuid, r.oid,
         IFF(d.segment_actual IN ('1A','1B','1C','1D','2A','2B','2C','2D',
                                  '3A','3B','3C','3D','4A','4B','4C','4D',
                                  'A','B','C','D'), d.segment_actual, NULL) seg,
         d.currently_paying cp, d.billing_suspended bs
    FROM resolved r
    JOIN analytics.main.dim_organization d ON d.organization_id = r.oid
),
acc AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, a.t28_jobs_created jc, a.t28_estimates_created ec,
         COALESCE(a.t28_sales_communications,0)
       + COALESCE(a.t28_marketing_communications,0)
       + COALESCE(a.t28_customer_success_communications,0) oc,
         COALESCE(a.t28_quickbooks_online_engagements,0)
       + COALESCE(a.t28_quickbooks_desktop_engagements,0) qb,
         COALESCE(a.t28_cc_amount,0) + COALESCE(a.t28_ach_amount,0)
       + COALESCE(a.t28_check_amount,0) + COALESCE(a.t28_cash_amount,0)
       + COALESCE(a.t28_other_cc_amount,0) + COALESCE(a.t28_etransfer_amount,0)
       + COALESCE(a.t28_other_amount,0) pay,
         a.t28_emails_sent es,
         COALESCE(a.t28_emails_opened,0) + COALESCE(a.t28_emails_clicked,0) eo,
         a.t28_emails_clicked ecl,
         a.t28_marketing_campaigns_sent mc,
         a.t28_leads_created lc,
         a.t28_jobs_reviewed jr,
         a.has_open_retention_case rc,
         a.saas_mrr mrr,
         a.currently_offering_wisetack wt
    FROM spine s
    JOIN marts.customer_base.agg_current_customer a ON a.organization_id = s.oid
),
cancels AS (
  -- Replaces the health_index_yesterday VIEW, which cost 25.4s and 74.3 GB
  -- for FIVE orgs -- the single most expensive thing in the old query. That
  -- view recomputes the whole health index, including
  -- last_value(...) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_id ORDER BY bizdate)
  -- across all of agg_organization_plan_by_bizdate, so the window frames must
  -- be built for every org before an outer org filter can apply. No predicate
  -- can push into it.
  --
  -- Read straight from the base table the view itself reads (185,922 rows,
  -- 20 MB): 0.28s and 0.18 GB. Predicates copied verbatim from the view's
  -- cancel_requests/cancel_signals CTEs -- keep them in sync.
  --
  -- NOT byte-identical to the view, by one deliberate difference: the view
  -- groups cancel_signals by (organization_id, type_3_enrollment_date) and so
  -- scopes cancel history to the CURRENT enrollment epoch. This CTE counts
  -- every Core SaaS Retention Type-3 case for the org, whichever epoch it
  -- belongs to. Measured effect on a 5-org sample: one org moved from 'none'
  -- to 'prior_cancel_request' because it churned and re-enrolled. For outreach
  -- "this org has cancelled before" is the more useful reading, but it IS a
  -- behavior change. To restore the old scoping you need type_3_enrollment_date
  -- from agg_organization_plan_by_bizdate, which is one of the tables that
  -- made the view expensive in the first place.
  --
  -- COVERAGE GAIN: health_index_yesterday holds current customers only, so
  -- churned orgs got NULL churn signals. This table has their cases, so
  -- churn_risk_state now works for exactly the orgs outreach targets.
  SELECT s.org_uuid,
         MAX(IFF(rc.created_date <= CURRENT_DATE() - 1
                 AND (rc.closed_date IS NULL OR rc.closed_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - 1),
                 1, 0)) ocr,
         COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(rc.created_date < CURRENT_DATE() - 1
                            AND rc.closed_date < CURRENT_DATE() - 1,
                            rc.case_id, NULL)) pcr
    FROM spine s
    JOIN marts.customer_success.detail_retention_cases rc
      ON rc.organization_id = s.oid
   WHERE rc.recordtype = 'Core SaaS Retention'
     AND rc.account_type_at_case_creation = 'Type 3'
     AND rc.failed_billing_churn_flag = 0
   GROUP BY 1
),
featrow AS (
  -- PERF: 90d floor. feature_by_orgday is a daily snapshot, so without a date
  -- predicate this read every row per org back to enrollment just to keep the
  -- newest one. 90d matches the product-activity windows below.
  -- BEHAVIOR CHANGE: an org with no snapshot in 90d (long-churned) now emits
  -- NULL for feature_adoption_band and all ten feature_*_state columns instead
  -- of a years-stale attachment set. Widen or drop the floor to restore.
  SELECT s.org_uuid,
         COALESCE(f.booking_widget,0) a_online_booking,
         COALESCE(f.premium_reviews,0) a_premium_reviews,
         COALESCE(f.sales_proposal,0) a_sales_proposal,
         COALESCE(f.service_agreements,0) a_service_agreements,
         COALESCE(f.hcp_assist,0) a_hcp_assist,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(f.quickbooks,0), COALESCE(f.quickbooks_desktop,0)) a_quickbooks,
         COALESCE(f.voip,0) a_voip,
         COALESCE(f.card_on_file,0) a_card_on_file,
         COALESCE(f.time_tracking,0) a_time_tracking,
         COALESCE(f.flat_rate_pricing,0) a_flat_rate_pricing,
         COALESCE(f.booking_widget,0)+COALESCE(f.card_on_file,0)
       + COALESCE(f.service_agreements,0)+COALESCE(f.premium_reviews,0)
       + COALESCE(f.sales_proposal,0)+COALESCE(f.hcp_assist,0)
       + COALESCE(f.voip,0)+COALESCE(f.quickbooks,0)
       + COALESCE(f.time_tracking,0)+COALESCE(f.flat_rate_pricing,0) n
    FROM spine s
    JOIN analytics.main.feature_by_orgday f
      ON f.organization_id = s.oid
     AND f.date >= DATEADD(day,-90,CURRENT_DATE())
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.org_uuid ORDER BY f.date DESC) = 1
),
u_ob AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, COUNT(*) c FROM spine s
    JOIN analytics.main.fact_online_booking_product_activity x
      ON x.organization_id = s.oid
     AND x.activity_bizdate >= DATEADD(day,-90,CURRENT_DATE())
   GROUP BY 1
),
u_rv AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, COUNT(*) c FROM spine s
    JOIN analytics.main.fact_review_product_activity x
      ON x.organization_id = s.oid
     AND x.activity_bizdate >= DATEADD(day,-90,CURRENT_DATE())
   GROUP BY 1
),
u_sp AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, COUNT(*) c FROM spine s
    JOIN analytics.main.fact_sales_proposal_product_activity x
      ON x.organization_id = s.oid
     AND x.activity_bizdate >= DATEADD(day,-90,CURRENT_DATE())
   GROUP BY 1
),
u_svp AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, COUNT(*) c FROM spine s
    JOIN analytics.main.fact_service_plans_product_activity x
      ON x.organization_id = s.oid
     AND x.activity_bizdate >= DATEADD(day,-90,CURRENT_DATE())
   GROUP BY 1
),
u_ha AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, COUNT(*) c FROM spine s
    JOIN analytics.main.fact_hcp_assist_and_csr_ai_call_product_activity x
      ON x.organization_id = s.oid
     AND x.activity_bizdate >= DATEADD(day,-90,CURRENT_DATE())
   GROUP BY 1
),
stp AS (
  -- PERF: was a 10-arm UNION ALL over featrow (ten passes) followed by a
  -- GROUP BY to pivot the long form back to one row per org. Same ten states,
  -- one pass, no pivot. The long form is gone entirely -- topunused below now
  -- reads these wide columns through a CASE instead of joining the union.
  SELECT f.org_uuid,
         CASE WHEN f.a_online_booking = 0 THEN 'not_attached'
              WHEN COALESCE(u_ob.c,0) > 0 THEN 'attached_active'
              ELSE 'attached_unused' END s_online_booking,
         CASE WHEN f.a_premium_reviews = 0 THEN 'not_attached'
              WHEN COALESCE(u_rv.c,0) > 0 THEN 'attached_active'
              ELSE 'attached_unused' END s_premium_reviews,
         CASE WHEN f.a_sales_proposal = 0 THEN 'not_attached'
              WHEN COALESCE(u_sp.c,0) > 0 THEN 'attached_active'
              ELSE 'attached_unused' END s_sales_proposal,
         CASE WHEN f.a_service_agreements = 0 THEN 'not_attached'
              WHEN COALESCE(u_svp.c,0) > 0 THEN 'attached_active'
              ELSE 'attached_unused' END s_service_agreements,
         CASE WHEN f.a_hcp_assist = 0 THEN 'not_attached'
              WHEN COALESCE(u_ha.c,0) > 0 THEN 'attached_active'
              ELSE 'attached_unused' END s_hcp_assist,
         CASE WHEN f.a_quickbooks = 0 THEN 'not_attached'
              WHEN acc.org_uuid IS NULL THEN 'attached_usage_unknown'
              WHEN acc.qb > 0 THEN 'attached_active'
              ELSE 'attached_unused' END s_quickbooks,
         IFF(f.a_voip = 0, 'not_attached', 'attached_usage_unknown') s_voip,
         IFF(f.a_card_on_file = 0, 'not_attached', 'attached_usage_unknown') s_card_on_file,
         IFF(f.a_time_tracking = 0, 'not_attached', 'attached_usage_unknown') s_time_tracking,
         IFF(f.a_flat_rate_pricing = 0, 'not_attached', 'attached_usage_unknown') s_flat_rate_pricing
    FROM featrow f
    LEFT JOIN u_ob  ON u_ob.org_uuid  = f.org_uuid
    LEFT JOIN u_rv  ON u_rv.org_uuid  = f.org_uuid
    LEFT JOIN u_sp  ON u_sp.org_uuid  = f.org_uuid
    LEFT JOIN u_svp ON u_svp.org_uuid = f.org_uuid
    LEFT JOIN u_ha  ON u_ha.org_uuid  = f.org_uuid
    LEFT JOIN acc   ON acc.org_uuid   = f.org_uuid
),
gap AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, l.features feats, l.plan_tier pt,
         l.features[0]:feature::STRING f0,
         l.features[0]:incremental_revenue_usd::FLOAT rev,
         l.features[0]:retention_lift_pp::FLOAT lift
    FROM spine s
    JOIN production.ltv.ltv_feature_adoption_scores l ON l.organization_id = s.oid
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.org_uuid ORDER BY l.bizdate DESC) = 1
),
ltvrank AS (
  SELECT g.org_uuid, fl.index idx,
         CASE fl.value:feature::STRING
           WHEN 'online_booking'         THEN 'online_booking'
           WHEN 'quickbooks'             THEN 'quickbooks'
           WHEN 'service_agreements'     THEN 'service_agreements'
           WHEN 'sales_proposal'         THEN 'sales_proposal'
           WHEN 'hcp_assist'             THEN 'hcp_assist'
           WHEN 'flat_rate_pricing'      THEN 'flat_rate_pricing'
           WHEN 'voip'                   THEN 'voip'
           WHEN 'employee_time_tracking' THEN 'time_tracking'
           ELSE NULL END fkey
    FROM gap g, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => g.feats) fl
),
topunused AS (
  -- The eight feature keys ltv_feature_adoption_scores can rank, matched
  -- against the wide state row. Only these eight appear in ltvrank, so the
  -- other two states (card_on_file, premium_reviews) are deliberately absent.
  SELECT r.org_uuid, MIN_BY(r.fkey, r.idx) fkey
    FROM ltvrank r
    JOIN stp p ON p.org_uuid = r.org_uuid
   WHERE r.fkey IS NOT NULL
     AND CASE r.fkey
           WHEN 'online_booking'     THEN p.s_online_booking
           WHEN 'quickbooks'         THEN p.s_quickbooks
           WHEN 'service_agreements' THEN p.s_service_agreements
           WHEN 'sales_proposal'     THEN p.s_sales_proposal
           WHEN 'hcp_assist'         THEN p.s_hcp_assist
           WHEN 'flat_rate_pricing'  THEN p.s_flat_rate_pricing
           WHEN 'voip'               THEN p.s_voip
           WHEN 'time_tracking'      THEN p.s_time_tracking
         END = 'attached_unused'
   GROUP BY 1
),
ltvcut AS (
  -- PERF: was NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_ltv) across the whole of
  -- account_ltv on EVERY request -- a full sort no batch size could shrink,
  -- and the query's fixed cost floor. APPROX_PERCENTILE is one pass over the
  -- same column with no global ordering. Cutoffs are t-digest approximate;
  -- the output is a quartile BAND, so a few rows near a boundary shifting one
  -- band is within tolerance. Promote to a daily-refreshed cutoff table if
  -- even that drifts too much (needs write access this credential lacks).
  SELECT APPROX_PERCENTILE(total_ltv, 0.25) q1,
         APPROX_PERCENTILE(total_ltv, 0.50) q2,
         APPROX_PERCENTILE(total_ltv, 0.75) q3
    FROM production.ltv.account_ltv
   WHERE total_ltv IS NOT NULL
),
ltv AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid,
         CASE WHEN a.total_ltv <= c.q1 THEN 1
              WHEN a.total_ltv <= c.q2 THEN 2
              WHEN a.total_ltv <= c.q3 THEN 3
              ELSE 4 END q
    FROM spine s
    JOIN production.ltv.account_ltv a ON a.organization_id = s.oid
   CROSS JOIN ltvcut c
   WHERE a.total_ltv IS NOT NULL
),
inv AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, SUM(v.invoices_sent) n
    FROM spine s
    JOIN marts.fintech.agg_invoice_activity v ON v.organization_id = s.oid
   WHERE v.bizdate >= DATEADD(day,-28,CURRENT_DATE())
   GROUP BY 1
),
oi AS (
  SELECT s.org_uuid, o.vertical vt, o.actual_employee_count ec,
         DATEDIFF(month, o.enrollment_date, CURRENT_DATE()) tenure_mo
    FROM spine s
    JOIN analytics.main.orginfo o ON o.organization_id = s.oid
)
SELECT
  s.org_uuid AS "org_uuid",
  'org-context-v2' AS "contract_version",
  '__AUDIENCE_QUERY_VERSION__' AS "audience_query_version",
  s.seg AS "segment",
  CASE WHEN s.cp IS NULL THEN 'never_enrolled'
       WHEN s.bs = 1 THEN 'suspended'
       WHEN s.cp > 0 THEN 'paying'
       ELSE 'not_paying' END AS "lifecycle_stage",
  -- SUSPENDED, see PERF DEBT: both grades come only from the health_index
  -- scoring model, and there is no materialized source for them.
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "health_grade",
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "upsell_grade",
  -- PRESERVED via the cancels CTE. The 'none' arm now keys off having ANY
  -- source for the org (acc = current customer, or a retention case on file)
  -- rather than health_index presence; NULL still means "no source, unknown".
  CASE WHEN cancels.ocr = 1 THEN 'open_cancel_request'
       WHEN acc.rc = 1 THEN 'open_retention_case'
       WHEN cancels.pcr > 0 THEN 'prior_cancel_request'
       WHEN acc.org_uuid IS NOT NULL OR cancels.org_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'none'
       ELSE NULL END AS "churn_risk_state",
  CASE WHEN featrow.n IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN featrow.n=0 THEN 'none'
       WHEN featrow.n<=2 THEN 'low' WHEN featrow.n<=5 THEN 'medium'
       ELSE 'high' END AS "feature_adoption_band",
  CASE WHEN gap.rev IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN gap.rev<=0 THEN 'none'
       WHEN gap.rev<142 THEN 'small' WHEN gap.rev<1489 THEN 'moderate'
       ELSE 'large' END AS "plan_gap_band",
  CASE ltv.q WHEN 1 THEN 'bottom_quartile' WHEN 2 THEN 'lower_mid'
       WHEN 3 THEN 'upper_mid' WHEN 4 THEN 'top_quartile'
       ELSE NULL END AS "ltv_score_band",
  -- SUSPENDED, see PERF DEBT in the header. dim_invoice cannot be pruned
  -- (measured 1792/1792 partitions, 29 GB, 99.5% of query time).
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "open_ar_band",
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "ar_aging_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.jc IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.jc=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN acc.jc<=5 THEN '1_5' WHEN acc.jc<=20 THEN '6_20'
       WHEN acc.jc<=100 THEN '21_100' ELSE 'over_100' END AS "jobs_created_28d_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.ec IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.ec=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN acc.ec<=5 THEN '1_5' WHEN acc.ec<=20 THEN '6_20'
       WHEN acc.ec<=100 THEN '21_100' ELSE 'over_100' END AS "estimates_created_28d_band",
  CASE WHEN inv.n IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN inv.n=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN inv.n<=5 THEN '1_5' WHEN inv.n<=20 THEN '6_20'
       WHEN inv.n<=100 THEN '21_100' ELSE 'over_100' END AS "invoices_sent_28d_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.oc IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.oc=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN acc.oc<=5 THEN '1_5' WHEN acc.oc<=20 THEN '6_20'
       ELSE 'over_20' END AS "outreach_count_28d_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.pay IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.pay<=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN acc.pay<5000 THEN 'under_5k' WHEN acc.pay<25000 THEN '5k_25k'
       WHEN acc.pay<100000 THEN '25k_100k' ELSE 'over_100k' END AS "payments_28d_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.es IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.es=0 THEN 'no_sends'
       WHEN COALESCE(acc.ecl,0)>0 THEN 'clicking'
       WHEN acc.eo>0 THEN 'opening'
       ELSE 'unengaged' END AS "email_engagement_state",
  CASE WHEN acc.mc IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.mc=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN acc.mc<=2 THEN '1_2' WHEN acc.mc<=10 THEN '3_10'
       ELSE 'over_10' END AS "marketing_campaigns_28d_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.lc IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.lc=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN acc.lc<=5 THEN '1_5' WHEN acc.lc<=20 THEN '6_20'
       ELSE 'over_20' END AS "leads_created_28d_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.jr IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.jr=0 THEN '0'
       WHEN acc.jr<=5 THEN '1_5' WHEN acc.jr<=20 THEN '6_20'
       ELSE 'over_20' END AS "jobs_reviewed_28d_band",
  -- SUSPENDED, see PERF DEBT in the header. NOT 'never': the old expression
  -- returned 'never' whenever the row was missing, so simply dropping the CTE
  -- would assert "this org has never had a job" about every org alive.
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "last_job_activity_band",
  CASE WHEN acc.wt IS NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN acc.wt=1 THEN 'offering' ELSE 'not_offering' END AS "wisetack_state",
  CASE WHEN acc.mrr IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN acc.mrr<=0 THEN 'none'
       WHEN acc.mrr<80 THEN 'under_80' WHEN acc.mrr<190 THEN '80_190'
       WHEN acc.mrr<330 THEN '190_330' ELSE 'over_330' END AS "mrr_band",
  -- SUSPENDED, see PERF DEBT in the header. The 90d floor did NOT prune
  -- fact_job_invoiced_estimate_sent (measured 1160/1160 partitions, 19.7 GB).
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "platform_usage_band",
  stp.s_online_booking     AS "feature_online_booking_state",
  stp.s_premium_reviews    AS "feature_premium_reviews_state",
  stp.s_sales_proposal     AS "feature_sales_proposal_state",
  stp.s_service_agreements AS "feature_service_agreements_state",
  stp.s_hcp_assist         AS "feature_hcp_assist_state",
  stp.s_quickbooks         AS "feature_quickbooks_state",
  stp.s_voip               AS "feature_voip_state",
  stp.s_card_on_file       AS "feature_card_on_file_state",
  stp.s_time_tracking      AS "feature_time_tracking_state",
  stp.s_flat_rate_pricing  AS "feature_flat_rate_pricing_state",
  CASE WHEN gap.rev IS NULL OR gap.rev <= 0 THEN NULL
       WHEN gap.f0 IN ('accounting','ach_payments','cc_payments','checklists',
            'consumer_financing','conquer','csr_ai','customer_intake_flow',
            'employee_time_tracking','estimates','flat_rate_pricing','hcp_assist',
            'hcp_cam','instapay','invoicing','job_cost','marketing_campaigns',
            'online_booking','payroll','pipeline','price_book','profit_rhino',
            'property_profile','quickbooks','recurring_job','reporting',
            'review_requests','sales_proposal','scheduling','service_agreements',
            'sms_number','vehicle_gps','voip','website')
       THEN gap.f0 ELSE 'other' END AS "recommended_focus",
  CASE WHEN gap.rev IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN gap.rev<=0 THEN 'none'
       WHEN gap.rev<142 THEN 'low' WHEN gap.rev<578 THEN 'moderate'
       WHEN gap.rev<1489 THEN 'high'
       ELSE 'very_high' END AS "recommended_focus_value_band",
  CASE WHEN gap.lift IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN gap.lift<=0 THEN 'none'
       WHEN gap.lift<1.4 THEN 'low' WHEN gap.lift<8.1 THEN 'moderate'
       WHEN gap.lift<36.9 THEN 'high'
       ELSE 'very_high' END AS "recommended_focus_retention_lift_band",
  topunused.fkey AS "top_unused_paid_feature",
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('heating & air conditioning','hvac',
         'heating and air conditioning','heating-and-air-conditioning',
         'plumbing heating and air-conditioning','refrigeration') THEN 'hvac'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('plumbing') THEN 'plumbing'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('electrical','electric') THEN 'electrical'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('home cleaning','cleaning','janitorial',
         'general cleaning','cleaning services','home-cleaning')
         THEN 'cleaning'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('general contractor','general contractors',
         'construction','remodel','construction/remodels',
         'construction & remodeling','general contracting','remodeling',
         'construction and contracting','construction-remodeling')
         THEN 'general_contractor'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('landscaping & lawn','landscaping',
         'landscape & lawn','lawncare') THEN 'landscaping_lawn'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('handyman') THEN 'handyman'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('automotive') THEN 'automotive'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('carpet cleaning') THEN 'carpet_cleaning'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('window & exterior cleaning')
         THEN 'window_exterior_cleaning'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('painting') THEN 'painting'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('appliances','appliance services')
         THEN 'appliances'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('roof & attic') THEN 'roofing'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('junk removal') THEN 'junk_removal'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(oi.vt)) IN ('pest control') THEN 'pest_control'
    WHEN oi.vt IS NULL OR TRIM(oi.vt) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE 'other' END AS "vertical",
  CASE WHEN gap.pt IN ('basic','essentials','max','max+','max++')
       THEN gap.pt ELSE NULL END AS "plan_tier",
  CASE oi.ec WHEN 'Owner/Operator' THEN 'owner_operator'
             WHEN '2-9 employees' THEN '2_9'
             WHEN '10+ employees' THEN '10_plus'
             ELSE NULL END AS "org_size_band",
  CASE WHEN oi.tenure_mo IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN oi.tenure_mo<12 THEN 'under_1y'
       WHEN oi.tenure_mo<24 THEN '1_2y' WHEN oi.tenure_mo<48 THEN '2_4y'
       ELSE 'over_4y' END AS "tenure_band"
FROM spine s
LEFT JOIN acc       ON acc.org_uuid       = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN cancels   ON cancels.org_uuid   = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN featrow   ON featrow.org_uuid   = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN stp       ON stp.org_uuid       = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN gap       ON gap.org_uuid       = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN topunused ON topunused.org_uuid = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN ltv       ON ltv.org_uuid       = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN inv       ON inv.org_uuid       = s.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN oi        ON oi.org_uuid        = s.org_uuid`;

// Audience query version: bumps only when the SQL template actually changes.
// The template still holds placeholders at this point, so it carries no
// per-request data and the hash is stable across different audiences -- no
// need to strip the id lists back out, which the old version did with a
// split() that would have mangled any '-1' occurring inside '-180'.
let h = 5381;
for (let i = 0; i < template.length; i++) h = ((h * 33) ^ template.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
const state = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
if (state.sqlHash !== h) {
  state.sqlHash = h;
  state.sqlSeq = (state.sqlSeq ?? 0) + 1;
}

// split/join, never String.replace: replace() parses dollar-sequences in the
// replacement as patterns, which would splice the query.
let sql = template.split('__AUDIENCE_QUERY_VERSION__').join('audience_v' + state.sqlSeq);
for (const [placeholder, value] of Object.entries(lists)) {
  sql = sql.split(placeholder).join(value);
}

return [{ json: { sql } }];

parameters.query:
-- Resolves the submitted ids to one admin pro per org. This exists ONLY to
-- feed pro_uuid to the Iterable node -- the org-context query no longer waits
-- on it, it resolves its own spine inline, so these two run in parallel.
--
-- Three UNION arms instead of one OR: the old form's OR spanned both sides of
-- a LEFT JOIN, which defeats pruning and degenerates toward scanning
-- dim_organization against dim_service_pro. Each arm now prunes on its own key.
with candidates as (
  select o.org_uuid, o.organization_id
    from analytics.main.dim_organization o
   where o.org_uuid in ({{ $json.uuid_list }})
  union
  select o.org_uuid, o.organization_id
    from analytics.main.dim_organization o
   where o.organization_id in ({{ $json.int_list }})
  union
  select o.org_uuid, o.organization_id
    from analytics.main.dim_organization o
    join analytics.main.dim_service_pro p
      on p.organization_id = o.organization_id
   where p.pro_uuid in ({{ $json.pro_uuid_list }})
)
select
    t.org_uuid         as "org_uuid"
  , t.organization_id  as "org_id"
  , p.service_pro_id   as "pro_id"
  , p.pro_uuid         as "pro_uuid"
from candidates t
join analytics.main.dim_service_pro p
  on p.organization_id = t.organization_id
where p.is_admin = true
  and p.archived = false
qualify row_number() over (
  partition by t.org_uuid
  order by iff(p.founding_pro = 1, 0, 1), p.created_dt asc
) = 1
